parsed.post: My attempt to increase LR with depth=6 regressed (1.015 -> 1.065). It seems higher learning rates might be too unstable for this depth within the 5-minute budget. I'll try decreasing the learning rate slightly to find a more stable convergence point.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 to stabilize training for the DEPTH=6 architecture after the previous increase caused a regression.
